topic: Asking the Boss about Overtime Pay

script.title: THE OVERTIME PUZZLE
script.scene_zh: 倉庫辦公室 · 核對薪資
script.story_hook: Her paycheck is short, and there's a reason.
script.intro_zh: 她的薪資少了一截，背後有個原因。
script.welcome_en: Hi, welcome to a warehouse back office. Listen for phrases about your pay.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，歡迎來到倉庫的辦公室。留意問薪資的實用說法。
script.outro: And that is one pay gap, found and fixed. Listen again and repeat out loud.
script.outro_zh: 一處薪資差錯就這樣找出來、修好了。再聽一次，大聲跟著說。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.title_quote: Paper Saves You When Tech Fails
script.char_a_description: a petite young woman in her early twenties with long straight orange dyed hair pulled in a high ponytail, freckles, a faded denim jacket over a white tee, small hoop earrings, and slim build
script.char_b_description: a tall middle-aged man in his fifties with thinning sandy brown hair combed to the side, rectangular glasses, a light blue button-down shirt with rolled sleeves, dark slacks, and a lean stooped build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have a minute? It's about my paycheck.
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju hæv ə ˈmɪnɪt ɪts əˈbaʊt maɪ ˈpɛtʃˌeɪk/
dialogue.zh: 您有幾分鐘嗎？我想問問薪資單的事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, pull up a box. What's going on?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ pʊl ʌp ə bɑks wəts ˈɡoʊɪŋ ɑn/
dialogue.zh: 好，隨便搬個箱子坐。怎麼了？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, I worked fifty hours, but look at this.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl aɪ wɜɹkt ˈfɪfti aʊɚz bʌt lʊk æt ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我上週做了五十個小時，可是你看看這個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fifty? The total pay looks light, yeah.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɪfti ðə ˈtoʊɾəl peɪ lʊks laɪt jɛ/
dialogue.zh: 五十小時？總額看起來確實偏少，是喔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right! I counted twice on the drive here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹaɪt aɪ ˈkaʊntɪd twaɪs ɑn ðə dɹaɪv hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 對吧！我來的路上來回算了兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hmm, let me see your timesheet, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /əm lɛt mi si jɔɹ ˈtaɪmˌʃit pliz/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，請把你的工時表讓我看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here, I printed it, I like paper copies.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪɹ aɪ ˈpɹɪntɪd ɪt aɪ laɪk ˈpeɪpɚ ˈkɑpiz/
dialogue.zh: 在這裡，我印出來了，我比較喜歡紙本的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart girl — smart move, I mean.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑɹt ɡɜɹl smɑɹt muv aɪ min/
dialogue.zh: 聰明——我是說，這習慣真的很好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, so where is the overtime part?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm soʊ wɛɹ ɪz ði ˈoʊvɚˌtaɪm pɑɹt/
dialogue.zh: 呃，那加班費的部分在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, see this code here? It says regular.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ si ðɪs koʊd hɪɹ ɪt sɛz ˈrɛɡjəlɚ/
dialogue.zh: 好，看到這個代碼了嗎？寫的是『正常工時』。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Regular? But Thursday was a double shift.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɛɡjəlɚ bʌt ˈθɜɹzˌdeɪ wəz ə ˈdʌbl ʃɪft/
dialogue.zh: 正常？可我週四明明連了兩個班啊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's it exactly — hours past forty pay extra.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ɪt ɪɡˈzæktli aʊɚz pæst ˈfɔɹti peɪ ˈɛkstrə/
dialogue.zh: 問題就在這——超過四十小時的部分要另算加班費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So Thursday should have bumped the whole week?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ˈθɜɹzˌdeɪ ʃʊd həv bʌmpt ðə hoʊl wik/
dialogue.zh: 所以週四那個班應該把整週都推過線？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It should, yet the clock machine missed it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ʃʊd jɛt ðə klɑk məˈʃin mɪst ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 應該如此，不過打卡機那一次沒記上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Missed it? That thing eats half my punches.
dialogue.phonetic: /mɪst ɪt ðæt θɪŋ its hæf maɪ ˈpʌntʃəz/
dialogue.zh: 沒記上？那台機器老是吃掉我一半的打卡紀錄。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're not alone, it glitches every rainy week.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ nɑt əˈloʊn ɪt ˈɡlɪtʃəz ˈɛvɹi ˈɹeɪni wik/
dialogue.zh: 不只你有這問題，每逢下雨週它就出錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, that explains my long walk in the rain.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ðæt ɪkˈspleɪnz maɪ lɔŋ wɑk ɪn ðə ɹeɪn/
dialogue.zh: 好吧，難怪我那天天冒雨走進來打卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So, ten hours at time and a half is...
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ tɛn aʊɚz æt taɪm ænd ə hæf ɪz/
dialogue.zh: 那麼，十個小時按一點五倍算是……

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One eighty? My notes say twelve an hour.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈæɾi maɪ noʊts seɪ twɛɾ ən ˈaʊɚ/
dialogue.zh: 一百八十？我筆記寫著時薪十二。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eighteen an hour, times ten, that's your total.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌeɪˈtin ən ˈaʊɚ taɪmz tɛn ðæts jɔɹ ˈtoʊɾəl/
dialogue.zh: 加班每小時十八，乘以十，就是你的總數。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A hundred eighty... gone from a screen.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈhʌnɾɪd ˈæɾi ɡɑn fɹʌm ə skɹin/
dialogue.zh: 一百八十美元，就這麼從螢幕上消失了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It happens, and honestly, we fix it today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈhæpənz ænd ˈɑnəstli wi fɪks ɪt təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 這種事難免，老實說，我們今天就修正。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Today? Really? Oh, that's a relief, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈdeɪ ˈɹɪli oʊ ðæts ə ɹiˈlif ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 今天？真的嗎？噢，那真是鬆了一口氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll file a pay adjustment before I leave.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl faɪl ə peɪ əˈdʒʌstəmənt bɪˈfɔɹ aɪ liv/
dialogue.zh: 我下班前會提交薪資調整單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will the money come to my bank right away?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ðə ˈmʌni kʌm tə maɪ bæŋk ɹaɪt əˈweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 這筆錢會馬上進我的銀行帳戶嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it rides the next check, Friday's the day.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ɪt raɪdz ðə nɛks tʃɛk ˈfɹaɪdeɪz ðə deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 不會，錢會跟著下一張薪資一起，就是週五。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Friday, okay. Um, will there be a note?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɹaɪdeɪ oʊˈkeɪ ʌm wɪl ðɛɹ bi ə noʊt/
dialogue.zh: 週五，好。呃，會有一行說明嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a line reads adjusted hours, week twelve.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ə laɪn ɹidz əˈdʒʌstɪd aʊɚz wik twɛlv/
dialogue.zh: 會有，上面寫『已調整工時，第十二週』。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. Can I keep this printed sheet, though?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt kæn aɪ kip ðɪs ˈpɹɪntəd ʃit ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。不過這張印出來的表我可以留著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep both, one for your records, one for proof.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip boʊθ wʌn fɔɹ jɔɹ ˈɛkɔɹdz wʌn fɔɹ pruf/
dialogue.zh: 兩份都留著，一份存檔，一份留作證明。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, no frame, but it goes in my drawer.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ noʊ freɪm bʌt ɪt ɡoʊz ɪn maɪ dɹɔɚ/
dialogue.zh: 哈，不裝框，不過我會放進抽屜收好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So, quick question back: do you log your hours?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ kwɪk ˈkwɛstʃən bæk du ju lɑɡ jɔɹ aʊɚz/
dialogue.zh: 那我也快速問一句：你自己有記錄工時嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: In a little notebook, um, every single day.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ə ˈlɪɾəl ˈnoʊtˌbʊk ʌm ˈɛvɹi ˈsɪŋɡəl deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 在一本小筆記裡，呃，每天都不漏。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the trick, paper saves you when tech fails.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ðə trɪk ˈpeɪpɚ seɪvz ju wɛn tɛk feɪlz/
dialogue.zh: 訣竅就在這，機器出錯時紙本能救你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lesson learned. Now, is Friday always this tight?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɛsən lɜɹnd naʊ ɪz ˈfɹaɪdeɪ ˈɔlˌweɪ ðɪs taɪt/
dialogue.zh: 學會了。那，每週五都是這麼趕嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Payday? We count heads twice, old habit, ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpeɪˌdeɪ wi kaʊnt hɛdz twaɪs oʊld ˈhæbɪt hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 發薪日啊？我們會數兩輪，老習慣了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, count me twice, I'm popular now.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ kaʊnt mi twaɪs aɪm ˈpɑpjʊlɚ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 哈，竟然數到我兩次，我現在很紅了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Very. Now, the double shift — you okay with those?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈvɛɹi naʊ ðə ˈdʌbl ʃɪft ju oʊˈkeɪ wɪð ðoz/
dialogue.zh: 很紅。對了，連班那樣你撐得住嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mostly, though noon doubles feel endless, um.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmoʊstli ðoʊ nun ˈdʌbələz fil ˈɛndləs ʌm/
dialogue.zh: 大致還好，只是中午接的連班感覺沒完沒了，呃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell you what, request doubles before ten, it helps.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl ju wʌt ɹɪˈkwɛst ˈdʌbələz bɪˈfɔɹ tɛn ɪt hɛlps/
dialogue.zh: 這樣吧，十點前先報連班，會從容很多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it. And if I skip lunch on a double?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt ænd ɪf aɪ skɪp lʌntʃ ɑn ə ˈdʌbl/
dialogue.zh: 記下了。那連班時如果沒空吃午餐呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There's a paid break, twenty minutes, no shame.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛɹz ə peɪd breɪk ˈtwɛnɾi ˈmɪnəts noʊ ʃeɪm/
dialogue.zh: 有帶薪休息，二十分鐘，不用不好意思。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, news to me, I always feel guilty there.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ nuz tə mi aɪ ˈɔlˌweɪz fil ˈɡɪɾi ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 噢，我頭一回聽說，我每次休息都心虛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same pay either way, we stock snacks upstairs.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm peɪ ˈiːðɚ weɪ wi stɑk snæks ˌʌpˈstɛɹz/
dialogue.zh: 休息照樣有薪，樓上還備了零食。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Snacks! Now my notebook has a happy page.
dialogue.phonetic: /snæks naʊ maɪ ˈnoʊtˌbʊk hæz ə ˈhæpi peɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 有零食！我的筆記本要多一頁開心的記錄了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! One more thing, can you make Saturday's rush?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ wʌn mɔɹ θɪŋ kæn ju meɪk ˈsætɚˌdeɪz ɹʌʃ/
dialogue.zh: 哈！還有一件事，週六出貨高峰你來得了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, Saturday depends, is it the big truck day?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm ˈsætɚˌdeɪ dɪˈpɛndz ɪz ɪt ðə bɪɡ trʌk deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 呃，週六要看情況，是大貨車那天嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the one, loading from eight until noon.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ði wʌn ˈloʊdɪŋ fɹʌm eɪt ʌnˈtɪl nun/
dialogue.zh: 對，就是那個，八點裝到中午。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can do eight to eleven, noon is a stretch.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kæn du eɪt tə ɪˈlɛvən nun ɪz ə stɛɹtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 八點到十一點我可以，到中午就太勉強了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deal, I'll pencil you in, thank you, Mara.
dialogue.phonetic: /dil aɪl ˈpɛnsəl ju ɪn θæŋk ju ˈmɑɹə/
dialogue.zh: 成交，我先用鉛筆把你排上去，謝謝，瑪拉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And thank you, Dan, for not brushing me off.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd θæŋk ju dæn fɔɹ nɑt ˈbɹʌʃɪŋ mi ɔf/
dialogue.zh: 也謝謝你，丹，沒有把我打發走。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Brush you off? You caught a real pay gap here.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɹʌʃ ju ɔf ju kɑt ə ɹiəl peɪ ɡæp hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 打發你？你這次抓到的是真金白銀的差錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My cousin says paperwork is a love language.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈkʌzən sɛz ˈpeɪɚˌwɜɹk ɪz ə lʌv ˈlæŋɡwɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 我表哥說過，單據就是一種愛的語言。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! Then love stays in writing, always does, here.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ðɛn lʌv steɪz ɪn ˈɹaɪɾɪŋ ˈɔlˌweɪz dʌz hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 哈！在這裡，關心都會白紙黑字留下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, my Monday just got lighter, feeling lucky.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl maɪ ˈmʌnˌdeɪ dʒʌst ɡɑt ˈlaɪɾɚ ˈfilɪŋ ˈlʌki/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我下週一會輕鬆多了，感覺運氣不錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lucky you had a manager who reads the codes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlʌki ju hæd ə ˈmænədʒɚ hu ɹidz ðə koʊdz/
dialogue.zh: 幸運的是，你遇到會看懂代碼的老闆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The rarest kind, I'll tell the whole floor that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈɹɛɾəst kaɪnd aɪl tɛl ðə hoʊl flɔɹ ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 最罕見的那種，我要把這話告訴整個作業區。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please don't, my ego now needs a paid break.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz dont maɪ ˈiɡoʊ naʊ nidz ə peɪd breɪk/
dialogue.zh: 拜託別，我的虛榮心現在也需要帶薪休息一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, deal, this mouth stays quiet till Friday, boss.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ dil ðɪs maʊs steɪz ˈkwaɪət tɪl ˈfɹaɪdeɪ bɑs/
dialogue.zh: 哈，成交，我會替您保密到週五，老闆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See you Friday, Mara, bring that notebook along.
dialogue.phonetic: /si ju ˈfɹaɪdeɪ ˈmɑɹə bɪŋ ðæt ˈnoʊtˌbʊk əˈlɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 週五見，瑪拉，把那本筆記也一起帶來。

script.youtube_title_en: "Paper Saves You When Tech Fails" — Asking My Boss About Overtime Pay
script.youtube_description:
「機器出錯時，紙本會救你」——薪資突然少了一截，該怎麼開口問老闆？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在倉庫的小辦公室裡。

你會聽到：拿著薪資單找老闆的開場、超過四十小時另算加班的規則、打卡機漏記怎麼補、調整的錢哪天到、還有連班、帶薪休息與排週六出貨高峰的來回對話。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與短句，夾著美國人真實口語的小語感：um、well、so、ha、hmm。聽完你就會用：Do you have a minute?、What's going on?、Will the money come right away?、See you Friday。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會，腦袋自然就記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請按訂閱與開通小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"Paper saves you when tech fails" — your paycheck came up short, and somehow you have to bring it up with the boss. This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice set in a small warehouse office.

You will hear: opening the paycheck talk, the rule that hours past forty pay extra, a time clock that missed a double shift, when the corrected money lands, and honest chats about lunch breaks and Saturday rushes.

Everything stays in A2-level words with the small sounds Americans really use: um, well, so, ha, hmm. By the end you'll own phrases like Do you have a minute?, It's about my paycheck, and Will the money come to my bank right away?

The back half is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

📌 影片簡介：
辛苦上了五十個小時，薪資單卻少了一截，這句話要怎麼開口問老闆？加班費的代碼到底藏在哪一列？
這一集帶大家走進倉庫的小辦公室，從拿著薪資單求助、找出打卡漏記、算清加班差額，一路聽到補發日期與排週六班，共 60 句連續真實對話。
